bio: Muhammad Shahid Hasan Khan is a Civil Engineer with more than 25 years of professional experience in civil engineering design, CAD documentation, construction supervision and project coordination. He completed a diploma in Civil Engineering from Faridpur Polytechnic Institute (FPI) in 1998, a B.Sc. in Civil Engineering from the University of Information Technology & Sciences (UITS) IN 2017 and an M.Sc. in Environmental Science from Stamford University Bangladesh (SUB) in 2023. His experience spans major railway and bridge infrastructure, urban building safety, institutional buildings, roads, culverts, telecom infrastructure and general building construction.
